Chat request with a tool definition; assistant responds with a tool call

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = client.chat_async(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(messages: [{ 'content' => 'What is the weather in San Francisco?', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'gpt-4', tool_choice: 'auto', tools: [LiterLlm::ChatCompletionTool.new(function: LiterLlm::FunctionDefinition.new(description: 'Get the current weather for a given location', name: 'get_weather', parameters: '{"properties":{"location":{"description":"The city and state, e.g. San Francisco, CA","type":"string"},"unit":{"description":"The temperature unit to use","enum":["celsius","fahrenheit"],"type":"string"}},"required":["location"],"type":"object"}'), tool_type: 'function')]))
puts result.choices.inspect
puts result.choices[0].message.tool_calls.inspect
puts result.choices[0].message.tool_calls[0].function.name.inspect
puts result.choices[0].finish_reason.inspect
```
